parts.t: Neighbourhood guide · City of Chilliwack · West Chilliwack
West Chilliwack is an MLS® sub-area name in the City of Chilliwack. The City doesn’t publish a boundary for it.
The closest official description is the City’s western rural and agricultural land, covered by the Agricultural Area Plan and the 2040 Official Community Plan’s Rural Areas land use map.
Evans Elementary, at 7600 Evans Road, sits in this area, and BC Transit’s route 52 is named Evans for the Evans Road corridor.

blocks.text: Planning and flood notes for West Chilliwack

parts.t: Plans, zoning and flood rules can be different for each lot.
The Agricultural Area Plan was prepared in 2012 and adopted as Schedule D3 of the 2040 Official Community Plan. It is now Schedule B1 of the 2050 plan.
The 2040 Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 4025, was adopted in 2014. Official Community Plan Bylaw 2025, No. 5500 (Chilliwack 2050) was adopted on December 16, 2025.
ALR: whether a parcel is in the ALR is set address by address. Check the ALC property map to confirm whether a specific West Chilliwack parcel lies inside the ALR.

Flood: the City’s Floodplain Regulation Bylaw 4519 designates the floodplains of the Fraser, Chilliwack and Vedder rivers and the Vedder Canal, plus the alluvial fans and floodplains of several creeks. Minimum building setbacks are 60 m from the Fraser River, 75 m from the Vedder River and 30 m from the Chilliwack River and Vedder Canal.
The City maintains an extensive diking network for the Fraser and Vedder River systems.
